protocol.scope: ChEMBL SINGLE PROTEIN catalog; single assay; measured IC50/type B; no pooling or decoys; evidence-based review shortlist only
protocol.criteria_status: New-run exploratory criteria fixed before any new campaign, developed after seeing DYRK3 and Task1 v1 outcomes; not blind preregistration or brief-mandated thresholds
protocol.budget_rationale: 250 limits 50 proposed queries to <=20% of the pool; >=500 is preferred (<=10%). Both are operational feasibility choices, not universal scientific standards. Initialization consumes 10 of the 50 queries.
protocol.diversity_rationale: Retain >=10 Murcko buckets and <=25% largest Morgan/Butina cluster. These are operational filters, not proof of generalization. Class minima and single-class initialization risk remain explicit.
protocol.interpretation: Assay-defined inhibition at IC50 <=1000 nM. Nonhit is only above that threshold; unknown is not inactive. IC50/type B/confidence 9 do not establish direct binding. All shortlist entries remain pending primary source/sample identity review and campaign protocol review.
